Frequently Asked Questions - La Crescenta

What types of cases do you handle in La Crescenta?

Car and motorcycle accidents, pedestrian injuries, slip and falls, dog bites, premises liability, and wrongful death claims throughout the Crescenta Valley.

I was rear-ended on Foothill - is my case strong?

Rear-end collisions often indicate fault by the trailing driver, but insurers still dispute injuries. We document treatment and lost wages to support your claim.

How soon should I contact an attorney in La Crescenta?

As soon as possible. Early investigation helps secure witness statements, photos, and reports before evidence disappears.

Can you help with a slip and fall at a local business?

Yes. Property owners must maintain safe conditions. We investigate maintenance records, prior complaints, and surveillance footage when available.

Do you offer Armenian-language support?

Our lead attorney serves many Armenian-American families in the Foothill communities. Ask about language preferences when you schedule your consultation.
